title: AI Adoption in S&P 500 Firms
abstract: arXiv:2607.08920v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: The adoption of artificial intelligence (AI) by large enterprises is an important potential source of aggregate productivity improvement and labor market impact. We study AI adoption of S&P 500 firms over the period 2016 to 2025, estimating adoption at the enterprise level. While generative AI tools are useful for personal and professional applications, our focus is on the deep integration of AI in the business processes of large enterprises which are bellwethers for firm adoption more broadly. We develop a novel measure to assess deep AI adoption (and distinguish it from AI hype) that is based on SEC 10-K filings, where laws and regulations ``prohibit companies from making materially false or misleading statements." In 2025, 11% of S&P 500 enterprises had AI deeply integrated into their business processes, and a further 10% were using AI in the production of goods and delivery of services. translated_abstract: arXiv:2607.08920v2 公告类型：替换 摘要：大型企业对人工智能（AI）的采纳是总体生产率提升和劳动力市场影响的重要潜在来源。我们研究了2016年至2025年期间标普500企业的AI采纳情况，并在企业层面进行采纳率估计。虽然生成式AI工具对个人和专业应用很有用，但我们的研究重点是AI在大型企业业务流程中的深度整合，这些企业是更广泛企业采纳趋势的风向标。我们开发了一种新颖的度量方法来评估深度AI采纳（并将其与AI炒作区分开来），该方法基于SEC 10-K年报文件，因为法律法规“禁止公司做出重大虚假或误导性陈述”。2025年，11%的标普500企业已将AI深度整合到其业务流程中，另有10%的企业在商品生产和服务交付中使用AI。AI的采纳率已从5（原文在此处截断，疑为“5%”）增长了超过四倍。
tldr: 该论文基于SEC 10-K年报开发了一种能够区分“深度AI采纳”与“AI炒作”的新颖度量方法，发现2025年标普500企业中11%已将AI深度整合进业务流程、另有10%在生产与服务交付中使用AI，采纳率自2016年以来已增长超过四倍。
en_tdlr: The paper develops a novel SEC 10-K filing-based measure to distinguish deep AI adoption from AI hype, finding that by 2025, 11% of S&P 500 firms had deeply integrated AI into their business processes and another 10% used AI in production and service delivery, with adoption more than quadrupling since 2016.
